correctness.rationale: For fixed hub, leaves independently wait their first rate-one copy; T is max of n+1 Exp(1) with CDF (1-e^-t)^(n+1), mean H_(n+1), centered Gumbel. For fixed positive leaf, the (hub state h, number k of positive ordinary leaves) generator is exact. From all-negative ordinary state F, the only changing exit has rate 1/(n+1); an excursion from (1,0) has uniformly bounded expected duration O(log n) by geometric spell completion. Degree-weighted M=h/2+(k+1)/(2(n+1)) has generator (1-h)/(2(n+1)), giving (2n+1)q=n+1+EB and q=1/2+O(log n/n). Geometric compounding of Exp(1/(n+1)) holding times gives exact exp(q/(n+1)) wait, and O(log n) excursions vanish at n scale. Reconstructed reduced finite-state rational generator and independently solved small n hitting times (n=1..6) as a bounded cross-check, not an asymptotic proof.

originality.rationale: Pinned internal star center versus leaf, with first all-positive passage and rate-one node clocks, is not the same as external opinion maker dynamics, unpinned star consensus or competing zealots. The surveyed primary literature and Resultary records address these related but different observables; no exact rate-1/2 leaf-pinned exponential first-passage law was found in material inspected. A finite-graph duality derivation remains a possible alias, openly recorded as residual risk.
